purpose_context: After the label taxonomy (#715) and topic-project creation (#716), the Vikunja task store still holds two structures at once. This mission runs the human-judgment migration — routing every task out of the six doomed projects into its correct topic project per Kent's locked manifest, applying the t:habit label, deleting test artifacts, and removing the emptied projects — so Felix task-intake and escalation reason over one coherent structure.
purpose_tldr: Move surviving Vikunja tasks into the new topic projects, label habits, and delete the emptied legacy projects.
